academic-paper-skills narrative scanner token count on canonical MANUSCRIPT_V3.md, retained as an allocation diagnostic rather than a venue limit.
Numbered manuscript bibliography entries; no TMLR reference-count limit was stated in the checked author guide.
One evidence-bearing table and no figures; displayed equations are part of the formal spine and are not counted as figure/table display items.
The schema v1 has no byte-size unit, so this row uses items as a typed numeric carrier for decimal megabytes: 119,620 bytes divided by 1,000,000. Official TMLR guidance permits up to 100 MB.
constraints.surface: Anonymous supplementary ZIP size in decimal megabytes

notes: The seven-page rendered length is measured, not inferred from words.
TMLR's any-length policy is recorded as none_stated rather than converted into an invented total limit.
The 100 MB supplementary limit is satisfied by a 119,620-byte anonymous ZIP in this candidate; the package builder rechecks its current bytes.
No P1-P3 function is underdeveloped or displaced by positioning, provenance or implementation detail.
Soft section percentages are deliberately absent because the contract forbids universal quotas.
